verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted AI assistant and agent platform, so reaching paired phones or computers is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no first-party device pairing, and nothing on remote screenshots, camera access, notifications, or media playback on other machines. Generic MCP integrations such as file system access or web browsers are only developer building blocks and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant reaches beyond one machine — paired phones and computers it can use for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback
